title: Resort-Style Escape: Pool, Courts, and Endless Fun
description:
Step into your dream desert getaway, perfectly situated in the heart of Scottsdale/Paradise Valley. From the moment you arrive, this resort-style retreat invites you to unwind and enjoy every moment. Picture yourself spending mornings perfecting your serve on the pickleball court, challenging friends to a game of half-court basketball, or setting up an epic volleyball match. Afterward, cool off in the sparkling heated pool or soak your cares away in the hot tub.

 The space 
The expansive outdoor space is designed for unforgettable gatherings. Practice your putts on the lush putting green, play a round of horseshoes, or challenge your group to a game of corn hole or outdoor ping pong. When it’s time to relax, retreat to the large shaded ramada, complete with a built-in BBQ for grilling feasts, a cozy fire pit for evening conversations, and plenty of seating to take in the breathtaking Arizona sunsets.

Inside, this thoughtfully remodeled home offers just as much to love. The spacious game room, equipped with a pool table and an arcade game, is perfect for some friendly competition. Multiple living areas provide ample space for everyone to spread out and enjoy. Whether you’re lounging, dining, or simply relaxing, the home’s comfortable design ensures you’ll feel at ease.

Located just minutes from Scottsdale’s top dining, shopping, hiking, and golf destinations, this home is the ideal balance of entertainment, luxury, and convenience. Whether you're planning a family vacation, a group getaway, or a relaxing retreat, this Scottsdale oasis is your home for unforgettable memories. Reserve your stay today!

Pool Heating*

Before booking this home, please review ALL house rules to make sure that this is the right home for you. Feel free to reach out with any questions.

VacayAZ enforces good neighbor policies on all managed properties. Renting homes in a neighborhood/community is a privilege and must be treated as such. Guests must be mindful of their noise levels at all times and respect the rules of the community. We do not provide speakers and/or sound systems on-site.

Anyone found to be violating noise ordinances will be subject to an immediate $500 fine, in addition to City-imposed fines which can reach up to $10,000 per violation and can be removed from the property due to negligence. 

Smoking is not allowed in this property. Violating this policy will result in forfeiture of the full security deposit and guests will be liable for the full cost of damage resulting from it.
